skill.name: set-up-cloudflare-meta-returning-customer-bidding
skill.description: Returning customer bidding for any website on Cloudflare (Cloudflare Tracking, no store plugin) in Meta. Use this skill when a merchant with a website on Cloudflare wants retention or win-back campaigns in Meta that value repeat orders. It sends every paid repeat order as a returning customer conversion, with its revenue or profit, to bid on. It works through Product Metrics, so use it even when Product Metrics is never mentioned. Not for new customer, POAS or LTV bidding: each has its own skill, as do other store platforms and ad channels.
skill.summary: Guide Meta Ads repeat purchase bidding with Cloudflare Tracking and Product Metrics.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most scanner alerts matched Markdown or routine setup checks; the retained matches involve writes, order access, remote instructions, and an unpinned installer. The workflow risks exposing a Meta token, granting unnecessary Cloudflare permissions, and starting live event delivery without a separate review. Conflicting profit event guidance can also include first orders in retention bidding.

remediation.issue: The assistant is told to request and forward a Meta Conversions API token.
remediation.suggestion: Require direct entry in the Product Metrics app or an approved secret manager. Never request tokens in chat or pass them as command-line arguments.

remediation.issue: Product Metrics writes can alter ongoing delivery to Meta without a separate approval step.
remediation.suggestion: Default to read-only. Confirm the provider, property, destination, and consent settings before any write. Require separate approval to start live sending after a consent test.

remediation.issue: Cloudflare troubleshooting tells users to approve every requested permission.
remediation.suggestion: List the minimum permissions and their purpose. Verify the account and zone, and stop if the authorization screen requests unexplained permissions.

remediation.issue: The main guide recommends a general profit event for repeat purchase bidding.
remediation.suggestion: Use the returning customer profit event and its matching purpose throughout the guide. Verify that an initial order does not satisfy the custom conversion.

remediation.issue: Order checks can retrieve more data than the classification requires.
remediation.suggestion: Verify the requested storefront, use test orders or a limited sample, and return only classification unless additional data is explicitly requested.

remediation.issue: The install example and documentation fallback can use unreviewed upstream content.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer and skill revision, and require user approval before installing. Bundle the reviewed guides or verify their integrity before following remote steps.

semantic_findings.title: Meta Access Token Solicitation
semantic_findings.description: The skill makes an exception to its secret handling rule and instructs the assistant to request and forward a Meta Conversions API token. This can expose the token in conversation or tool execution records.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The guide says to enter the token in the app, but also says the assistant must ask for it. The main instructions explicitly permit forwarding the token to a command.

semantic_findings.title: Live Event Delivery Without Explicit Approval
semantic_findings.description: The workflow defaults to keeping event sending on and proceeds from testing to live delivery. It does not require separate approval of the destination and consent configuration before shopper data starts flowing.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions verify a test with consent and then remove the test code. They describe the transmitted customer fields but do not require verifying withheld consent before going live.

semantic_findings.title: Blanket Cloudflare Permission Approval
semantic_findings.description: The troubleshooting guide tells the merchant to approve every permission without naming required scopes or explaining each grant. The integration advertises tracking across every page of the selected domain.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The blanket approval advice is explicit. The files do not show the requested Cloudflare scopes, so the actual access granted cannot be verified.

semantic_findings.title: General Profit Event Can Misguide Retention Bidding
semantic_findings.description: The main skill points users to the general order profit event instead of the returning customer profit event. That choice can include non-returning orders in the campaign signal.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The main guide and the returning customer guide name different profit events and purpose filters. The reference explicitly says unknown customers can still produce general profit events.

content.user_title: Set Up Meta Repeat Purchase Bidding with Cloudflare
content.value_statement: A standard purchase event does not distinguish repeat buyers from other customers. Use Product Metrics to verify repeat orders and set up a dedicated Meta conversion for retention campaigns.
actual_capabilities: Checks setup status and identifies unfinished steps for a Product Metrics property.
Guides a Cloudflare workspace admin through linking a storefront and setting up tracking.
Uses scoped order checks to verify whether Product Metrics recognizes a returning buyer.
Guides the merchant through configuring a Meta custom conversion for repeat purchase revenue or profit.
Explains how to verify repeat purchase events in Meta Events Manager and check delivery status.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics, a proxied Cloudflare storefront, and access to the correct Meta pixel or dataset.
Only recognizes identified buyers with prior purchases observed since tracking began. It cannot confirm that other buyers are new.
Profit events require complete cost estimates, and refunds do not revise events already sent to Meta.
The merchant must authorize Cloudflare access and select the optimization event in Meta.

use_cases.title: Check storefront readiness
use_cases.description: Find out whether the storefront, purchase tracking, and Meta destination are ready before setting up a retention campaign.

use_cases.title: Choose a repeat purchase goal
use_cases.description: Compare repeat purchase revenue and profit as optimization goals, then plan a custom conversion for one retention ad set.

use_cases.title: Diagnose an event missing from Meta
use_cases.description: Compare test order classification, consent settings, and Meta delivery status to find why the repeat purchase event is missing.

prompt_templates.title: Check setup requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: What do I need to set up repeat purchase bidding in Meta for my Cloudflare storefront? Give me a checklist without connecting any services.

prompt_templates.title: Review my setup status
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the setup status for [property]. Tell me what is ready and what is missing. Do not change settings or ask for credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Validate repeat purchase tracking
prompt_templates.prompt: Check [first test order] and [second test order] for the same test buyer. Report only their classifications and what to verify in Meta.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: verify the signal before campaign changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a profit-based pilot
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [property] for repeat purchase profit readiness. Identify the correct Meta event, rule, and delivery checks. Leave settings unchanged and mark steps that need approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare one retention ad set for profit optimization.

output_examples.input: Check whether my storefront is ready for repeat purchase bidding.
output: Cloudflare Tracking is active, but the Meta destination is not connected.
Confirm the intended Meta pixel and enter its access token directly in the Product Metrics app.

output_examples.input: What do my two test orders show?
output: The first order is Unknown. The second order is Returning because Product Metrics had already observed a paid order from the same identified buyer.
Check Meta Test Events for the repeat purchase revenue event before creating its custom conversion.

best_practices: Verify the storefront scope, Cloudflare permissions, and Meta dataset before authorizing any connections.
Enter the Meta token directly in the Product Metrics app and keep credentials out of chat.
Use two test purchases from the same identified buyer and verify consent and event delivery before starting live sending.
anti_patterns: Do not label unknown buyers as new or expect purchases from before tracking began to count.
Do not use the general order profit event for a campaign intended to optimize only for repeat purchases.
Do not treat a test event as proof of live delivery or consent enforcement.

faq.question: Do I need a store plugin?
faq.answer: No. This workflow uses Cloudflare Tracking on a proxied storefront instead of a store platform plugin.

faq.question: How does Product Metrics identify a returning buyer?
faq.answer: Product Metrics must identify the buyer and have already observed a paid order from them on the website.

faq.question: Do purchases from before tracking started count?
faq.answer: No. Product Metrics does not import earlier purchases through Cloudflare Tracking.

faq.question: Can I bid on repeat purchase profit?
faq.answer: Yes, if the order has complete cost estimates. Use the returning customer profit event rather than the general order profit event.

faq.question: Why is the repeat purchase event missing in Meta?
faq.answer: Meta must receive the event before it appears in the selector. Check that the test buyer qualifies as returning and granted marketing and analytics consent.

faq.question: Where should I enter my Meta access token?
faq.answer: Enter it directly in the Product Metrics app. Do not paste it into chat.
